verdict.rationale: Flagright clearly documents configurable transaction-monitoring rules. Its Management API lists rule templates and lets you create and update live rule instances, and marketing cites a no-code nested-logic rule engine plus rule simulation. However, nothing in the evidence shows thresholds can be set per segment (e.g., by user type, risk level, or geography). missing for 10: evidence of segment-specific threshold or parameter configuration, documentation of rule-instance parameters, independent or hands-on corroboration.
